sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा व्याहृतं वाक्यं रक्षसा ब्रह्मरूपिणा ।भक्ष्यसंस्कारकुशलमुवाच पृथिवीपतिः ।। ७.६५.२२ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ rakṣasā brahmarūpiṇā ।bhakṣyasaṁskārakuśalamuvāca pṛthivīpatiḥ ।। 7.65.22 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that speech spoken by the demon disguised as a Brahmin, the king then addressed the person skilled in preparing food.
